title: This One Mistake Cost a Seller $38,000 — Don’t Let It Happen to
description:
Get a free 1-on-1 strategy call with our team → https://realestatesteph.co
We'll break down your local market, run the numbers, and give you a game plan tailored to YOU.
Two nearly identical homes. Same neighborhood. One got $15,000 more — with a lower list price.
In this real-life case study, I’m breaking down exactly how we beat the competition — and it had nothing to do with listing higher.

👉 I’ll show you:

How pricing slightly lower can drive higher net profits

The math behind closing costs, concessions & commissions

Why days on market can silently drain your profit

What a $5K roof surprise teaches you about timing

🏡 I’m Stephen Harris, Central Texas broker helping sellers keep more money at the closing table — not lose it to poor strategy.
